ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light gray) surface pixels with approximately 15% coverage of low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and in focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity field across the ventral lobes, bounded by a continuous low-intensity black margin. Discrete, roughly circular dark blobs are distributed primarily in the lower-medial and lower-lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 55 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels forming a jagged boundary from the notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating at the median notch, transitioning to a straight/slightly convex trajectory terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of ~20 dark, circular/oval pixel clusters (5-15 pixel radius) scattered across the light ventral field, concentrated heavily in the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical yellowish-brown linear pixel disruptions located 20-40 pixels left and right of the median notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular focal pigmentation anomalies (scars) and minor irregular tissue loss/notching along the lateral trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical vertical yellowish-brown staining originating from the fluke-peduncle junction and extending toward the trailing edge notch.
